definitions.full: H2128. Ziph זִיף proper name 1. proper name, of a location a. city south east from Hebron , Josh 15:55 ; 1Chr 2:42 ; 2Chr 11:8 , modern Tell Zîf ; Rob BR i. 492, 498 Guérin Judée iii. 159 ff. : ׳מִדְבַּרזֿ 1Sam 23:14-15 , 26:2 (twice in verse); with ה locative, זִ֫יפָה 23:24 . b. city of southern Judah Josh 15:24 , site unknown. 2. proper name, masculine a son of יְהַלֶּלְאֵל of Judah 1Chr 4:16 , whether related to proper name, of a location above does not appear. ᵐ5 Ζαφα , Ζιφ ( αι ). ( 1Chr 2:42 see above)
